note: Stretches of the pred.gg public match stream whose ranked matches are in this folder. via "daily" = every ranked match in [from, to] (npm run perks); via "sample" = spaced pages across [from, to], NOT every match; via "backfill" = every ranked match in [from, to], re-read after the fact (while backfill-state.json exists it is still running and to is its cursor). Day files are <YYYY-MM-DD>.jsonl.gz by match end time (UTC); see engine/src/ingest/team-comps.ts for the row format.
